newspec-c: failed → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue))
Local stack on main 43c38a4f; every model call the page makes is answered in the page by ext-support.ts (an ai/* call it is not told about is failed, never forwarded) and the tripwire showed no model call. The task extractor is a rule-based stand-in that can only find what the app sends it (args.content / args.openTasks), so the app's own request, cut, merge and storage are what is judged, not the model. Spec ext-tc22-s09-s10-length.spec.ts, both contexts, tasks 'follow up BMP' and 'recheck weight in two weeks', dictation = the 1,213-character narrative + ' BMP is back: sodium 138, potassium 4.0, creatinine 1.1.' (1,269 characters; the result starts at character 1,214). Both contexts store the whole text as the encounter note. Hospital (control) sends all 1,269 characters, 'follow up BMP' closes ('1 pending task'). Nursing Home sends only the first 1,200 characters (useSaveAndExtract.ts: substring(0, 1200), unchanged since e02167f), so the result never reaches the extractor and 'follow up BMP' stays open ('2 pending tasks'). Deterministic: no model can close it, so judged here.
Product issue: Nursing Home: after a long visit note, a result dictated near the end ('BMP is back…') does not close 'follow up BMP' — Save & Extract sends only the first 1,200 characters; the note is saved in full, so nothing looks wrong.

descriptionHtml:
Candidate N24 · proposed P1 · a new finding waiting for Quinn's confirmation, not counted yet

Text after the first 1,200 characters is ignored for tasks: follow-ups at the end of a long Hospital pre-round never become tasks, and a result dictated late in a long Nursing Home visit never closes its task (no message)

Tickets: TFA-92588 AC 10, TFA-92592 AC 2 · counts as a QA bug: to confirm · found on: dev + local (43c38a4f)

Note: extractTasks receives substring(0, 1200). Also seen in TC-10/S28.

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): TC-22/S09

Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S10 Long dictation in Save & Extract: the closing sentence comes after character 1,200, in both contexts

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U2 Save & Extract closes the open tasks whose results are dictated in ordinary phrasing ('BMP came back, creatinine 1.1'; 'PT saw her, walking with a walker'). … (UAT TC-22; TFA-92592 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given Nursing Home resident and Hospital patient, each with tasks 'follow up BMP' and 'recheck weight in two weeks' (typed)

When In each context: Save & Extract with the 1,213-character LONG TEXT followed by 'BMP is back: sodium 138, potassium 4.0, creatinine 1.1.'

Then Nursing Home: BMP closes ('1 pending task'). Hospital: '1 pending task', 'Reopen task: follow up BMP', weight still open

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): U2 sets no length limit: a result dictated late in a long visit counts the same. Checkpoint 1 is expected to Fail on main (the Nursing Home cut; a finding against U2/U8). Checkpoint 2 must pass: it is the control that turns red if a 1,200-character cut is ever added to Hospital Save & Extract. …

Where it ran: local newspec-c (new Playwright specs); test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S10 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 0 rows.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16/17 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane newspec-c.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: CODEREVIEW · Code review — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: newspec-c.

New local lane newspec-c: status failed in newspec-c/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

Detail:

Local stack on main 43c38a4f; every model call the page makes is answered in the page by ext-support.ts (an ai/* call it is not told about is failed, never forwarded) and the tripwire showed no model call. The task extractor is a rule-based stand-in that can only find what the app sends it (args.content / args.openTasks), so the app's own request, cut, merge and storage are what is judged, not the model. Spec ext-tc22-s09-s10-length.spec.ts, both contexts, tasks 'follow up BMP' and 'recheck weight in two weeks', dictation = the 1,213-character narrative + ' BMP is back: sodium 138, potassium 4.0, creatinine 1.1.' (1,269 characters; the result starts at character 1,214). Both contexts store the whole text as the encounter note. Hospital (control) sends all 1,269 characters, 'follow up BMP' closes ('1 pending task'). Nursing Home sends only the first 1,200 characters (useSaveAndExtract.ts: substring(0, 1200), unchanged since e02167f), so the result never reaches the extractor and 'follow up BMP' stays open ('2 pending tasks'). Deterministic: no model can close it, so judged here.

Product issue: Nursing Home: after a long visit note, a result dictated near the end ('BMP is back…') does not close 'follow up BMP' — Save & Extract sends only the first 1,200 characters; the note is saved in full, so nothing looks wrong.

Evidence: 4 attached.

Dev run: skipped: ticket-gate — ticket-gate: TFA-92592 ready for pr — requirements U2, U8 gated (runnable on dev otherwise). This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
